title: Delhi HC Full Bench: Commercial Courts Act Applies Even to Suits Filed Before 2015 Once Renumbered
case_name: Yes Bank Ltd. v. Modi Rubber Ltd. & Anr.
card_summary: Yes Bank's wider appeal against an order letting Modi Rubber amend its plaint survived only if the pre-2015 appeal regime still applied once the suit was renumbered as a commercial suit. A three-judge bench held the Commercial Courts Act, 2015 governs such suits even if filed before the Act. Since an Order VI Rule 17 amendment order is not appealable under Order XLIII, Yes Bank's wider appeal right did not survive.
card_tip: Check whether an old suit has since been renumbered into the commercial division before assuming the pre-2015 appeal route is still open; the Commercial Courts Act's restricted appeal mechanism can apply retrospectively.
